A2-01.ko: 작은 빛 불꽃 튕김 · 촛불 같은 빛이 톡 되받음
A2-01.atk: a tiny wooden practice blade flicks forward: a light swish, a dry tap, then a small candle-flame sparkle popping off the fingertip
A2-01.def: a thin padded vest takes the knock with a soft thump, then a tiny flame-like spark flashes back at the attacker with a faint glassy tick

A2-03.ko: 짧은 검 서툰 휘두름 · 맨몸이 퍽 맞음
A2-03.atk: a light shortsword is swung a little clumsily: a quick leather-grip creak, a thin whoosh, a modest steel clack against the target
A2-03.def: no shield to lift: the squire flinches, cloth tunic rustles, a dull body thump and one scuffing boot slide on flagstone

A2-04.ko: 깃털 파닥 · 쓰러져도 따뜻한 빛이 받침
A2-04.atk: a small hop and a flurry of tiny feather flaps, a soft pat of a little fist on the foe, a faint high sparkle trailing off
A2-04.def: the child tumbles with a soft cloth plop, then a warm airy glow gently cushions it: a low breathy hum and a few feathers drifting

A2-05.ko: 창 자루 찍어 내림 · 성벽 위 가죽 갑옷 부딪힘
A2-05.atk: a spear butt is stamped on stone, then thrust forward: a crisp boot click, a short air hiss, a steel tip tapping into leather
A2-05.def: a light buckler knocks the blow aside with a tight metallic tink, boots scraping on a stone parapet, a faint ring in the air

A2-06.ko: 지팡이 끝 등불이 휙 · 천 외투가 맞아 구름
A2-06.atk: a travelling staff is swung with a hanging lantern on its tip: a wooden whoosh, a small glass-and-brass clink, a soft flare of light on impact
A2-06.def: a thick woolen cloak absorbs the hit with a muffled thump while the lantern glass rattles and its flame flutters with a gentle hum

A2-07.ko: 검 뽑아 단칼 내리침 · 갑옷 맞아 무겁게 휘청
A2-07.atk: a longsword drawn with a clean steel rasp, one decisive downward cut, then a bright metallic ring-out as it lands
A2-07.def: bare of shield, the knight takes it on a breastplate: a flat armour clang, rattle of plate joints, a heavy step back

A2-09.ko: 방패 앞세워 돌진 · 작은 방패에 챙 하고 튕김
A2-09.atk: a short stabbing sword jabs from behind a raised guard: a rapid scrape, a punchy thrust, and a clipped chain-mail jingle
A2-09.def: a small round shield catches the blow with a sharp clank and a quick ring, the arm wobbling with a creak of leather straps

A2-11.ko: 빛 창을 길게 찌름 · 창 자루로 비껴 막음
A2-11.atk: a long spear levelled and driven forward: a bright forged-light hum, a long whistling thrust, a clean piercing tick with a streak of shimmer
A2-11.def: the spear shaft is turned crosswise to parry: a hard wooden crack, a glancing glassy scrape along the tip, no solid ring

A2-13.ko: 은빛 장검 가름 · 가시 번쩍 되돌림
A2-13.atk: a silver arming sword sweeps in a level arc: a polished steel whistle, a ringing clang on contact, a rising glint of sunlight
A2-13.def: a kite shield takes the strike with a rich metallic clang and a deep thud, then a sharp sunrise flash spits back with a crisp crackle

A2-15.ko: 맹세의 철퇴 내려침 · 굳게 선 갑옷이 낮게 울림
A2-15.atk: a heavy flanged mace lifted and brought down in a solemn overhead smite: a slow metal creak, a deep dull crunch, a low bell tone swelling afterwards
A2-15.def: planted firmly with plated greaves, the body absorbs the blow with a deep armour thud and a low sustained bell ring that fades slowly

A2-16.ko: 질서 있는 발걸음 후 짧은 연타 · 둔탁한 두꺼운 몸
A2-16.atk: a tramp of boots in step, then a quick slash with a curved blade: a cloth swish, a short slicing zing, a dull clip on the target
A2-16.def: a thick stack of padded gambeson soaks the blow: a fat muffled thump, a creak of straps, a long exhale of dust from the cloth

A2-17.ko: 등불 번쩍이며 훑음 · 유리등이 흔들려 짤랑
A2-17.atk: a brass-framed lantern is raised and flares: a bright rising whine of light, a sweeping beam hiss, then a sharp crackle where it scorches the foe
A2-17.def: the glass lantern swings and rattles on its chain, a thin pane-like ring absorbing the hit, the flame wavering with a soft flutter

A2-20.ko: 날개 펼쳐 덮쳐 베기 · 큰 날개가 깃털 펄럭이며 감쌈
A2-20.atk: enormous wings snap open with a big feathery boom, a gust, then a longsword sweeps down with a deep steel whoosh and a weighty clang
A2-20.def: a vast pair of wings folds across the front: a dense wall of feather flutter, a muffled whump, and a soft hanging shimmer of settling down

A2-21.ko: 방패 앞세워 밀어침 · 이름 새긴 방패가 깊게 울림
A2-21.atk: a heavy sword-and-board shoulder charge: a stamp of sabatons, a shield rim bash, then a broad sword chop with a deep clang
A2-21.def: a large engraved shield takes the strike with a resonant boom and a rolling metallic ring, small etched plates buzzing in sympathy

A2-22.ko: 금빛 향로 휘둘러 종처럼 울림 · 두꺼운 제의로 묵직하게 받음
A2-22.atk: a gilded censer swung on a chain: a chain whirr, a heavy brass swing, a thick bell-like gong as it strikes, incense-like glitter trailing
A2-22.def: layered heavy ceremonial robes absorb the blow with a plush thud while a deep sacred bell rings out once, warm and long

A2-24.ko: 쌓인 빛벽이 밀침 · 얇은 유리벽이 맑게 금감
A2-24.atk: a pane of stacked light surges forward like a shoving wall: a rising crystalline hum, a rushing swell, a broad glassy slam
A2-24.def: a thin standing wall of glowing glass takes the hit: a clear sharp chime, faint spiderweb crackle, then the pane re-settling with a smooth shimmer

A2-25.ko: 지휘검이 높이 가름 · 큰 방패에 일출 가시
A2-25.atk: a commander's broadsword is raised, signalled with a bright metallic flick, then swept down: a deep whoosh, a heavy gleaming clang and a rolling ring-out
A2-25.def: a heavy tower shield booms deeply under the blow, plate groaning, and a bright sunburst flash cracks back at the attacker

A2-27.ko: 뽑힌 성검 한 번에 베기 · 서서 칼날로 받아 맑게 울림
A2-27.atk: a great sword slides from its sheath with a long pure scrape, hangs a moment, then one clean lightning-quick cut rings bright like struck crystal
A2-27.def: the upright blade is turned to catch the hit: a ringing steel tone, a crisp shower of tiny sparks, a long fading resonance

A2-28.ko: 성채 같은 몸으로 몸통 박치기 · 거대한 판금이 돌처럼 울림
A2-28.atk: a lumbering full-plate charge ending in a halberd chop: rumbling footfalls, a heavy axe-blade whoosh, a ground-shaking crunch
A2-28.def: a body of plate like a fortress: an immense stony boom, deep armour rumble and a dense low ring, as if a gate has slammed

A2-29.ko: 오래된 대검 묵직한 횡베기 · 낡은 갑옷이 세월 소리로 받음
A2-29.atk: a worn greatsword is hauled round in a slow flat arc: aged leather creak, a low rolling whoosh, a heavy ringing chop with a scrape of nicks
A2-29.def: old scarred plate gives a seasoned, weary clank, dents flexing back, a deep stone-like thud and a long calm exhale of metal

A2-30.ko: 불꽃 날개 휘몰이 · 날개 불꽃이 막아 낮게 웅웅
A2-30.atk: six burning wings sweep forward: a rush of flapping air, crackling golden flame, then a blazing swelling roar that bursts into sparkling embers
A2-30.def: blazing wings snap shut across the body: a thick whoosh of feathers, a fiery crackle absorbing the blow, and a low warm halo hum

A2-31.ko: 저울 추 같은 대검 내려침 · 금빛 갑옷이 저울처럼 울림
A2-31.atk: a massive judging blade is lifted slowly and dropped: a long metallic scrape, a still beat, then a thunderous bright hammer-fall of steel and light
A2-31.def: an unmoving golden plate takes the blow with a deep gong-like boom, balanced scale chains swaying with a quiet clinking afterwards

A2-33.ko: 거대한 방패로 밀어냄 · 거대한 방패가 종탑처럼 울림
A2-33.atk: a colossal shield is slammed forward like a gate: a huge heavy swoosh, a ground-trembling bash, a broad bronze-like clang with a spreading light flare
A2-33.def: a monumental shield absorbs everything: one huge belltower boom, a deep rolling resonance through stone, and a steady golden hum that does not crack

A2-34.ko: 양손 성광 내리침 · 성스러운 후광이 흘려보냄
A2-34.atk: a heavy gleaming warhammer is lifted in both hands and brought down in an overhead smite: a slow rise of radiance, a gong-like thud, a bright pulsing blast of light
A2-34.def: a soft golden halo flares around the body and the blow slides off in a smooth liquid shimmer, a low calm hum rising and fading

A2-36.ko: 여섯 날개 내리쳐 빛 폭발 · 빛 날개가 몸을 감싸 울림
A2-36.atk: wings of dawn spread with a huge feathered boom, a mounting radiant swell, then a blazing sunrise lance of light slams down with a brilliant chime cluster
A2-36.def: six great wings shut around the body in layered feather rushes; a high bright ring of sunlit glass and a deep warm hum swallow the strike

A2-41.ko: 방패 없이 맨몸으로 달려 찌름 · 갑옷 없이 부딪혀 나뒹굼
A2-41.atk: an unshielded sprint, a rattle of light armour and wing-folded rush, then a spear lunge punching right through: a sharp pierce crack and a flash of light
A2-41.def: bare of defence, it is bowled over: a hard body thud, a clatter of dropped steel, wings crumpling with a quick feathery rustle

A2-42.ko: 하늘에서 한 번 찍어 관통 · 얇은 몸이 번쩍하고 쓰러짐
A2-42.atk: a long executioner's blade is raised high and plunges with a falling whistle, one pierce-through crack, then an enormous lightning-bright boom of light
A2-42.def: a lightly built body folds under the blow with a thin metallic clatter, wing feathers scattering and a short fading ring

A2-43.ko: 불꽃 날개 날려 자폭 돌진 · 타다 흩어지는 재
A2-43.atk: burning wings ignite with a roaring flare, then it streaks forward like a comet: a rising firestorm rush, a piercing crack through the target, a blazing detonation of sparks
A2-43.def: frail wings crackle and curl under the blow, embers tinkling like falling glass, a short sizzle and a fading orange hiss

SP-A2.ko: 황금 성검 천둥 가름 · 날개와 보호막이 겹쳐 울림
SP-A2.atk: a golden sword and rising wings: a heavy feather boom, a long shining blade sweep, a thunderous clang with layered bell-like overtones blossoming outward
SP-A2.def: a ringing coin-like shield of light blossoms in front, a deep sunburst bell tone, wings fanning, and a clear glassy sparkle as the blow dissolves

UN-A2.ko: 날개 펼쳐 대신 맞음 · 날개 그늘이 휙 드리워 막음
UN-A2.atk: a feathered shield-wing is swung like a battering ram: a huge air-parting whoosh, a heavy feather-and-steel slap, a bright crack, a soft downy flutter after
UN-A2.def: a giant wing sweeps across to take the hit for an ally: a rush of feathers, a deep shadowy thump, a dim shaded hum falling over the impact like a curtain

UN-A2-7.ko: 새벽 종 내리쳐 빛 번쩍 · 사제복에 빛이 살아남
UN-A2-7.atk: a staff topped with a sun bell is struck down: a ringing swing, a pure crystalline gong, then a shimmering surge of morning light breaking like a wave
UN-A2-7.def: robes absorb the hit with a soft thud, then a rising warm glow and a gentle upward chime, like a fallen thing standing again

EP-A2-1.ko: 작은 날개 퍼덕이며 검 돌려침 · 큰 방패에 빛 보호막 코인
EP-A2-1.atk: small wings flick open, a sword slash whips round: a quick steel-edge snick, a bright ringing clang, and a coin-sized flash of light off the guard
EP-A2-1.def: a big shield catches the blow with a bright ring, and a tiny coin-shaped ward spins up around it with a quick chiming glimmer and a firm thud

EP-A2-2.ko: 장벽 위에서 장창 찔러 박음 · 어둑한 방패가 빛을 되받음
EP-A2-2.atk: a heavy pike jabs out from behind a wall: a long dry hiss, a deep iron-headed thrust with a hard crunch, a violet-gold glow flickering at the tip
EP-A2-2.def: a thick shield with a dim glowing rim blocks with a dense iron boom, a sunset-coloured hum envelops it, and a hard counter-flare snaps back

EP-A2-3.ko: 여섯 날개 후려침 · 날개 아래 커다란 후광 천막
EP-A2-3.atk: a great wing sweeps in, then a lance of dusk-gold light thunders down: a huge feathered gust, deep swelling bell hum, a heavy brilliant impact
EP-A2-3.def: a vast feathered canopy unfurls overhead and a large halo of light flares like a shimmering dome, sunlight chiming against the blow with a glassy ring

PN-A2-C1.ko: 방패 밀어 툭 치기 · 방패 내리지 않고 버팀
PN-A2-C1.atk: a small round shield nudged forward in a poking bash: a short leather creak, a flat wooden thump, a timid metallic tap
PN-A2-C1.def: the shield is held fast and the arm braces: a firm wooden-and-iron thud, boots digging in, a short stubborn creak that does not give

PN-A2-C2.ko: 돌벽 같은 몸으로 슬쩍 밈 · 변하지 않는 성벽처럼 육중
PN-A2-C2.atk: a heavy mailed shoulder shoves with little force: stone-like footfalls, a muted chain-mail rattle, a slow dull knock
PN-A2-C2.def: immovable as a wall: a very deep stony thump, no wobble, mortar-dust sifting, and a calm single low ring from the plates

PN-A2-C3.ko: 장벽 순찰 도끼 내려침 · 서서 버티며 묵직하게 울림
PN-A2-C3.atk: a swing of a heavy battle axe with a deep whoosh, a meaty chop and a rattle of mail, fading with a dusk-like low hum
PN-A2-C3.def: the patrol braces against a stiff wind of force: a solid steel clang, boots grinding on stone, a long muffled ring settling like a closed gate

PN-A2-U1.ko: 새긴 맹세 검 번쩍 · 가시 번쩍임과 단단한 판금
PN-A2-U1.atk: an engraved longsword flicks out with a crisp whistle, a clean slash, a bright clang that carries etched-metal overtones
PN-A2-U1.def: plate with etched runes takes the blow with a steady clang, hums softly, and returns a snapping flash of light as the attacker recoils

PN-A2-U2.ko: 유리 종 연타 · 울림이 겹쳐 버팀
PN-A2-U2.atk: a cluster of glass bells swung together: a bright scattered chime burst, a swelling light surge, a sharp radiant crack on target
PN-A2-U2.def: a ring of hanging glass bells vibrates around the body, absorbing the hit in layers of soft chime and a shimmering hum that holds steady

PN-A2-R.ko: 새벽빛 반사하는 방패로 밀침 · 칼날이 빛에 미끄러져 튕김
PN-A2-R.atk: a gleaming polished shield is shoved edge-first: a bright polished-metal swish, a sharp rim crack, a bar of sunlight flashing across
PN-A2-R.def: an enormous round shield tilted to the dawn: the blade skates off with a bright metallic zing, a gentle halo glimmer, and a firm unyielding thud

PN-A2-E.ko: 봉인의 대검 땅 울림 · 보호막이 겹겹 맞물림
PN-A2-E.atk: an ancient greatsword drags and swings with a long ringing scrape, a heavy sealed-gate boom and a deep resonant gong bursting with pale light
PN-A2-E.def: layered ward upon ward: a coin-like halo shield rings once, a deep door-like thud follows, pale bars of light locking into place with grinding chimes

UP-A2-11.ko: 돌진하는 창 · 창이 날개 아래 비껴남
UP-A2-11.atk: a lowered lance in a galloping charge: hoof-like pounding, a rising wind whistle, a bright penetrating crack, light splitting like torn silk
UP-A2-11.def: a horse-like body shifts aside under the lance haft, a shield-edge scrape, a snort and a sharp parry clack with light fizzing

UP-A2-15.ko: 서약 철퇴 벼락 내림 · 서약 갑주가 낮은 종소리
UP-A2-15.atk: a covenant mace swung down with a heavier deeper smite than before: a stone-like crunch, a bell tone, then a golden pulse of light rippling out
UP-A2-15.def: a full covenant plate suit rings with a rich deep bell tone, a long steady thud, then three faint echoing hums of oaths held

UP-A2-17.ko: 큰 등불 눈부신 훑음 · 그림자 없는 빛 막
UP-A2-17.atk: a large lantern's beam sweeps wide: a whining white flare, a shadow-erasing hiss, a bright pitiless crack on the foe
UP-A2-17.def: a tall lantern ward spins a net of light: pane-like chimes cascade, the blow is swallowed with a soft deep hum and a gentle shimmer

UP-A2-22.ko: 큰 종 한 번 더 울림 · 두꺼운 후광이 받아 냄
UP-A2-22.atk: an enormous bell tolls with a deep gong as a gold crozier slams down: a gigantic swelling clang, rolling brass overtones, a brilliant white burst
UP-A2-22.def: a great tower bell rings out once more and a thick halo of golden light soaks the blow, bass hum, echoing across stone

UP-A2-24.ko: 삼중 빛벽 밀어 쾅 · 겹친 유리벽 연달아 금감
UP-A2-24.atk: three layered light walls shoved forward like a landslide: a rumbling glassy roar, a tall crushing slam, shards of light raining down
UP-A2-24.def: stacked sheets of glowing glass absorb the blow in sequence: crack, ring, crack again, then a deep stony settling thud and a steady glow

MA-02.ko: 맨 앞 기사 위 빛 보호막 내림
MA-02.cast: a warm descending swell of light settles over the front knight, a soft glassy bubble forming with a bright chime as armour plates unclasp with a metallic loosening

SA2-01.ko: 성벽에서 나팔 한 번 · 앞줄 달려나감
SA2-01.cast: a single long brass war horn blast echoes off a wall, then rows of boots begin pounding and a rising sword-rattle swell surges forward

SA2-02.cast: a small glowing disc coalesces from tiny sparkling motes: a soft rising shimmer, a smooth glassy snap as it locks in, a gentle ring

SA2-03.cast: wings unfold over a comrade behind: a broad feathery spread, a protective low swell, a soft hushed ring of a promise sealed like a latch closing

MA-08.cast: molten gold light pours over every ally and cools into iron: a low pouring hiss, a metallic hardening clink, a final deep anvil-like ring

SA2-04.cast: a falling sword blow with a hard bright crack, followed by a recoil of light that swirls around the knight with a gentle shield chime

MA-10.cast: a long row of shields snap together one after another with sharp clacks, a spreading shimmer of light along the line, one coin-like chime

SA2-07.cast: glowing chains shoot out with a quick links-rattle, wrap with a smooth hum, clamp with a bright snap, and tension creaks softly

MA-14.cast: a vast eye-like radiance opens with a deep rising swell, harsh white light sears across the foe with a sizzling crackle, then softens into a warm sheltering hum

RA2-1.cast: the sky brightens with a rumbling rising whine, a pause, then a world-filling booming flash of light shaking everything, leaving a bell-like silence over one sheltered figure

NA2-1.cast: a high thin whistle of a falling spear, a split-second hush, then a blinding crack as it pierces down and a stone-cracking thud, light ringing out

NA2-2.cast: six huge wings beat overhead in a deep feathery thunder, drifting light feathers fall with tiny tinkles, each ally gains a soft shimmering ward

US-A2-1.ko: 모든 아군 손에 빛의 검이 쥐어짐
US-A2-1.cast: a deep blade-forging ring, light pouring into every weapon with a rising sparkle, then a brilliant unison of blades unsheathing with a crisp metallic swell

US-A2-2.ko: 한낮 햇살이 가장 높은 칼을 태움
US-A2-2.cast: a blazing high-noon swell, concentrated beams scorching with a searing crackle and the hiss of melting steel, then a quiet protective chime

PS-A2-1.cast: a gentle first-light shimmer rising, a bright touch of ring on each shield, then a deep solid lock-in tone like a bolt sliding home

PS-A2-2.cast: a calm descending wash of light, blades clattering one by one as they settle flat, then an even smooth glassy hum evening everything out

RS-A2-1.ko: 햇살이 눈을 멀게 하고 창이 달려듦
RS-A2-1.cast: a sudden sunrise flash with a rising bell-like crescendo, thundering hoofbeats and ringing lances rushing forward, one sharp gap-finding pierce at the end

RS-A2-2.cast: a huge wing spreads with a deep feather boom, a heavy armour step forward, then a bright ward blooms with a ringing shield tone and a wide soft shimmer

RS-A2-3.cast: a circle of light is drawn with a clean glowing hiss, a protective dome humming up around the ally, while a rival's blade dulls with a dim downward whine

CS-A2.ko: 숨은 마법이 사라지고 창끝에 빛이 맺힘
CS-A2.cast: a clean wave of light sweeps across, a hidden trap fizzles out with a short sealed pop and a puff of hush, then a lance tip flashes with a bright ring

IA2-1.ko: 장검을 허리에 차고 한번 휘둘러 봄
IA2-1.equip: a longsword is slid into a leather scabbard, a belt buckle clicks, and one test draw whispers with a bright steel ring

IA2-2.equip: a polished silver shield's straps are pulled tight with a leather creak, a buckle snaps, and a tap with a knuckle rings clear and bright

S2-1.equip: a sigil pendant on a thin chain is hung round the neck: a delicate chain jingle, a soft glowing hum, a faint chime

I3-2.equip: a tall tower shield is lifted and planted with a deep thud on stone, a gate-like iron hinge creak, and a long low ring when knocked

IA2-5.equip: a holy sword is raised from its sheath with a long pure scrape, a warm swelling of light settling on the blade, one gentle bell tone

S4-1.equip: a small reliquary box clicks open on stiff gold hinges, a hush of light spills, glassy sparkles hover, a single low chime

SR-A2.equip: a tall longbow is strung with a tight wooden bend, a bowstring is pulled with a creak and released in a test twang, a faint shimmering whistle trails away

IR-A2.ko: 맹세 방패를 팔에 끼우자 빛이 번짐
IR-A2.equip: a heavy oath shield clamped onto the forearm with a buckle snap, a soft golden glow spreading, and a coin-like ring when it is rapped

PI-A2.equip: a large feather is slid into an armour clasp with a silky whisper, the plate stiffens with a soft metallic hum, and a faint glimmer of light drifts away

TK-A2-1.ko: 빛 검 반짝 휘두름 · 빛 방패가 꿈쩍 않고 맞음
TK-A2-1.atk: a sword of woven light hums into being and slashes: a fresh electric-glass whine, a clean cutting swish, a tinkling shimmer where it ends
TK-A2-1.def: a body of light stands firm: the strike lands on a faint glowing shield with a soft crystalline thump, light rippling like water and settling back
